raw_text: [[File:{{{Alt}}}|28px|link=]] "Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side" Summary The Action Figure is an Epic piece of Equipment for the Archer Queen . It was first seen in the Friend or Foe medal event, debuting in April 2025. Since June 3, 2025, it may appear in the Trader , where it is obtainable for 1,500 Gems. The Action Figure is a doll of a Giant with a bare chest, brown and orange bands on his arms and legs, and green underpants. When the ability is used, the Archer Queen will summon a Giant Giant , in addition to turning invisible for 1 second. The level of the Giant Giant depends on the level of the Action Figure. In addition to the ability, the Action Figure grants additional damage per second, hitpoints, and self-regeneration to the Archer Queen. Strategies Offensive Strategies This Hero Equipment can be used as a superior version of the Magic Mirror . It pairs well with the Giant Arrow , Healer Puppet , Archer Puppet , and Frozen Arrow . Additionally, it can also be paired with the Magic Mirror for more damage to creating a funnel for the main army, like Dragons . Since the Giant Giant that spawns has very high amounts of hitpoints, it is a good idea to pair this up with an Apprentice Warden , since his uncapped HP boost can significantly impact the Giant Giant himself, allowing him to tank more. Be careful of Inferno Towers and Monoliths, as they are able to take down the Giant Giant, so use Freeze , Invisibility , or Overgrowth Spells to stop them from attacking. Skeleton Spells and Bat Spells can also help in this regard. It functions as an alternative to the Mighty Yak for the Archer Queen, as a bulky meatshield for her that also helps her break through Walls . This is especially useful when another Hero is using it, and allows the Archer Queen to use a different pet . When the defense he is targeting through a Wall is destroyed, he may target another building, wasting all of the Wall damage. It can be seen in his demonstration clip when the X-Bow is destroyed by the Archer Queen. Defensive Strategies When defending against this Equipment, place high-damage defenses away from each other, otherwise the attacker will get a lot of value from these spells mentioned above. Similarly, placing defenses at least 1 tile away from Walls will prevent the Giant Giant from dealing damage to them while he is attacking said Walls. Defending Heroes like the Barbarian King and Minion Prince are especially good tanks, as they are able to distract the Giant Giant and the Archer Queen so that defenses will have more time to defeat them. Inferno Dragons can significantly drain the hitpoints of the summoned Giant Giant because of his high damage. The summoned Giant Giant cannot jump over Walls, however they can deal massive damage to them, just in case if the Archer Queen wants to destroy a closed compartment. Therefore, place low-tier defenses on the outside to expose the Archer Queen, rendering the tank useless.
